name: Nomvula Dlamini
headline: Senior People Operations Manager
summary: Senior People Operations professional with 8 years of experience leading recruiting, HRIS implementation, and people analytics initiatives across mid-sized organizations. Skilled at building scalable HR processes, partnering with leadership on workforce planning, and using data-driven insights to improve retention and employee experience.

responsibilities: Lead end-to-end recruiting strategy for technical and commercial roles across three regional offices
Oversee HRIS platform administration, ensuring data accuracy and system optimization
Build people analytics dashboards to track attrition, engagement, and hiring funnel metrics
Partner with senior leadership on org design and workforce planning initiatives
Manage a team of two HR generalists and mentor junior recruiters
Managed full-cycle recruiting for retail and corporate positions nationwide
Administered HRIS system migrations and maintained employee records
Developed people analytics reports for quarterly leadership reviews
Coordinated onboarding programs and improved new-hire retention rates
Handled employee relations cases and disciplinary processes
Supported recruiting efforts for operations and warehouse staff
Maintained HRIS records and processed employee lifecycle changes
Assisted with payroll input and benefits administration
Compiled basic HR reports for management review
